origin: New complete seed adaptation, written and edited by Codex under Martin Melcop Neto portfolio direction. Not restored, rewritten or canon-approved historical B01.
source_available: Maintained SEED.md P04 summary, author mandate and narrative-production guidance. Historical Lightnovel Darkfantasy v0.4.48.zip and its full manuscript are not present in this checkout. Archive inventory contains Rave/WebSocket families, not P04 prose.
retained_seed_elements: Aevren reconstructs older knowledge, rather than inventing all world systems
Darsen is cosmopolitan; nonhuman workers have practical agency
A small maintenance/intrusion incident can demonstrate a rule of the world
new_adaptation_choices: New Sava/Nera/Lesto/Eno/Tila, plot, waterworks and social arrangements. Broad Saelir hands are a local character detail, not an asserted historical species canon.

Corpse muscle requires contact/intact tissue; no resurrection, answering soul, healing of broken joints or remote worker intelligence. Aevren own embodied existence is assumed by the lich premise, not a new full cosmology.
Baldino remains alive and narrates witnessed events after the incident; no ghost/post-death knowledge. No fixed year or Aevren/Garran/Dorian identity equivalence.
Sava emergency permission to use the body is constrained, not portrayed as unpressured consent or forgiveness. Water cleanup, injuries, family testimony and pending accountability follow the rescue.
